title: Beyond Corpus-Driven Imitation: Evolving Musical Mindsets in the Agentic Orchestra via Quantum Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24290v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a framework for computer-aided music composition and performance based on quantum reinforcement learning and multi-agent interaction. We introduce the agentic orchestra, where musical agents evolve distinct mindsets through trial-and-error engagement with a musical environment, rather than through training on large datasets. The agents are implemented as parameterised quantum circuits. They evolve distinct compositional behaviours, referred to as mindsets. This enables the exploration of musical decision spaces using quantum superposition and entanglement within a hybrid quantum-classical loop. We present two complementary agent architectures: atomistic agents, which process pitch and rhythm independently, and holistic agents, which handle pitch and duration as unified note events. translated_title: 超越语料库驱动的模仿：通过量子强化学习在智能体管弦乐队中演化音乐心智
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一个基于量子强化学习和多智能体交互的计算机辅助音乐创作与演奏框架。我们引入了“智能体管弦乐队”的概念，其中音乐智能体通过与音乐环境的试错交互来演化出独特的“心智”，而非通过在大型数据集上进行训练。这些智能体以参数化量子电路的形式实现，演化出不同的作曲行为，即所谓的“心智”。这使得能够在混合量子-经典循环中，利用量子叠加与量子纠缠来探索音乐决策空间。我们提出了两种互补的智能体架构：原子式智能体，独立处理音高与节奏；以及整体式智能体，将音高与时值作为统一的音符事件进行处理。心智通过扎根于音乐本身的奖励函数来塑造，这些奖励函数可以进行组合与加权，从而发展出不同的心智……
tldr: 本文提出“智能体管弦乐队”框架，将音乐智能体实现为参数化量子电路，通过量子强化学习与音乐环境的试错交互（而非模仿大型语料库）演化出独特的作曲心智。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the "agentic orchestra" framework, where musical agents implemented as parameterised quantum circuits evolve distinct compositional mindsets through trial-and-error quantum reinforcement learning with a musical environment, rather than imitating large corpora.
